errors.evidence: The x-axis labels are 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, which are at two-year intervals, not one-year intervals.
This describes the range of the data points on the line, not the range of the Y-axis itself, which extends from 0 to 0.9.
The figure uses a comma as a decimal separator (e.g., "0,9", "0,4902"), not a point.
The description omits the range of the y-axis (0 to 0.9) and the interval of its major ticks (0.1).
The description fails to mention two key data points that define the line's shape: the significant dip to 0,2362 in 2014 and the peak value of 0,7639 in 2018.
The phrasing is awkward. A more natural way to express this in Bulgarian would be "През 2016 г." (In the year 2016).
